# zillizcloud_service_account (Resource)

Manages an organization or project-local Service Account, including all its roles and project assignments. Organization accounts use exactly one of org_role_id or project_assignments. Project-local accounts use project_scope and optional project_role_ids. Delete all associated API keys before deleting the account. A disabled account must be enabled before editing metadata or permissions; use a separate apply to enable it before creating or updating keys.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Organization account with project access.
resource "zillizcloud_service_account" "ingestion" {
  name        = "ingestion-service"
  description = "Production ingestion"
  project_assignments = {
    "proj-a" = ["r-project-writer"]
    "proj-b" = []
  }
}

# Organization account with one predefined organization role.
resource "zillizcloud_service_account" "organization" {
  name        = "billing-automation"
  org_role_id = "r-billing-admin"
}

# Project-local account. Its owning project cannot be changed in place.
resource "zillizcloud_service_account" "project" {
  name             = "project-automation"
  project_scope    = "proj-a"
  project_role_ids = ["r-project-writer"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Unique account name, 1–128 characters, without leading or trailing whitespace.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description. An empty string clears it.
- `org_role_id` (String) Predefined Billing Admin or Org Owner role ID. Mutually exclusive with project_assignments and project_scope. To clear all access, omit this field and set project_assignments = {}.
- `project_assignments` (Map of Set of String) Complete map of project IDs to sets of project role IDs for an organization account. Use an empty set to assign a project without roles, or {} for no assignments. Removing a map entry unassigns that project. Mutually exclusive with org_role_id and project_scope.
- `project_role_ids` (Set of String) Complete role ID set in project_scope for a project-local account. Omitted or [] grants no roles.
- `project_scope` (String) Owning project ID for a project-local account. Omit for an organization account. Changes replace the account.
- `status` (String) Account status: active or disable. Disabling makes all associated keys unusable.

### Read-Only

- `create_time` (String) Creation time in UTC ISO 8601 format.
- `created_by` (String) Creator email or API key ID.
- `creator_name` (String) Creator display name.
- `id` (String) Service Account ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
terraform import zillizcloud_service_account.ingestion sa-example
```
